caption: Operating in CEPT countries under Recommendation T/R 61-01: the three documents a US Amateur Extra operator carries — evidence of the FCC license grant (your license), proof of U.S. citizenship (your passport), and a copy of FCC Public Notice DA 16-1048 itself. An Amateur Extra or Advanced grant earns full CEPT Radio Amateur License privileges, while a General grant earns CEPT Novice privileges only (ECC Recommendation (05)06). No “/CEPT” suffix and no local-language ID requirement exists; in the Americas the counterpart permit is the IARP.
